description:
Three whole-fact clones in src/compiler2/jobs/semantic.rs, each made to release World:
- :2012 world.function_contract(function).cloned() in refine_function_call_surface (also reached from activation_contract_return :2109): all spec arrows plus the extern wire. Only the violation path needs the whole World again.
- :1585 world.protocol_dispatch(protocol).clone() in resolve_protocol_call: every arm with its callback map, to read one callback per arm.
- :355 define_callsite_summary(call.key.clone(), call.resolution.clone()): the resolution is read afterwards only for CallSiteTargets::of (:361) and a resolved flag (:433-436).
Shape: contract and &mut Types lent together (see work_graph_and_types); protocol arms as compute-then-commit over (target, callback); call-site resolution moved in after the two reads.
Out of scope unless it falls out: :228 alternatives.clone(), which the reader judged to need a handle.
Heat: per call target, per protocol call site and per call site, per AnalyzeActivation run.

Method: .agent/strategies/ownership-shape.md. Change the signature and let cargo check enumerate dependents; resolve interleavings by compute-then-commit or a split borrow; stop and report if an Rc is the only move.
Signal: pure refactor. Full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves. Report the clone/to_vec count of each touched file before and after.
Sites were read at develop 8bf8775ae and not compiled; confirm each with cargo check before relying on it.
